verdicts.reason: A and B look the same at pixel level. Each one shrinks the original to the middle of the canvas instead of rearranging it for the shorter banner. The building photo starts about 175px in, leaving a blank strip on the left, and the right-aligned headline stops near x≈600, leaving about 170px of empty space on the right. The headline is shrunk to roughly half its original size, so it is weak and hard to read in a 72px-tall banner. The composition is no longer edge to edge, which loses the bleed of the original.
